Inspired by Bitcoin Magazine’s October 19, 2026 story about friends paying with bitcoin at Pita Cafe and Echo Coffee, this map brings the article’s 219 Arizona merchants into the real world.

Browse, save a few favorites, and make a day of it. Bitcoin works best when you get to use it.

Bitcoin acceptance comes from the article. Lightning badges and map locations come from BTC Map / OpenStreetMap; two addresses use the US Census geocoder. Listings are a snapshot imported October 20, 2026. Check with the business before a special trip.
